'''Lava spiders''' are monsters found within the [[Dragonkin Laboratory]]. 

They are typically found in small clusters, are [[aggression|aggressive]] and have a large [[attack range]]. They use rapid, but generally inaccurate [[ranged]] attacks which are capable of inflicting a weak [[poison]].

In story mode their health is reduced by 50% and their damage output is reduced by 90%.
